verdict.rationale: The evidence covers only single machines: multi-GPU types with up to 8 A100s and NVLink for GPU-to-GPU transfer within a machine. There is no documented way to provision a multi-node cluster with a fast inter-node interconnect. Private networking and shared drives are building blocks a user would have to assemble themselves, not a cluster product. High-end H100 machines also require approval, which cuts against the no-sales-cycle part of the story.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, I can provision a multi-node GPU cluster with fast interconnect for distributed training without a sales cycle
